news.title: Anthropic's Mythos sends US banks rushing to plug cyber holes
news.snippet: U.S. banks are rushing to fix scores of IT system weaknesses flagged by Anthropic's powerful but costly Mythos AI tool, prompting urgent repairs, software upgrades...

tech.title: What Is Agentic AI? A Complete Guide for 2026
tech.snippet: Agentic AI is artificial intelligence that takes goal-directed action on its own — planning, calling tools, and adapting until a task is done. This guide covers what makes AI agentic, how it differs from chatbots and copilots, the 6 levels of autonomy, real-world tools, and how to evaluate them.
